We need to find minimum total length after concatenating all strings in order (given order of words in array is fixed? Wait, the description says you must perform n-1 join operations, each time either join(str_{i-1}, words[i]) or join(words[i], str_{i-1}). So you cannot reorder words; you can only choose orientation (prepending or appending) each step. The order of processing words is fixed as given in the array (starting from index 0 as base string). So we need to process words sequentially, each step you can either append the next word to the current string, or prepend it.

Goal: minimize final length after processing all words.

Given that join(x, y) reduces length by 1 if the last char of x equals first char of y (overlap of 1). In joining, you can think of overlapping one character when concatenating.

Thus each step, when adding a new word w (words[i]), you either concatenate current string S at its end with w (S + w) with overlap if last char of S equals first char of w; or you prepend w to S (w + S) with overlap if last char of w equals first char of S (since join(w, S) checks last char of w vs first char of S).

Goal: minimize final length after processing all words, starting with S = words[0].

We can think of DP: state after processing i-th word (i.e., having processed words[0..i]) is the resulting string S_i (some string). However, we don't need full string, only need its first and last character, because future joins only depend on the ends. Indeed, the future cost for adding next words depends only on first and last char of current S_i (the overlap possibilities). The internal part length is additive sum of lengths minus any overlaps we get. So we can maintain DP that tracks minimal total length achievable for each possible pair (first_char, last_char) after processing i words.

Thus DP[i][c1][c2] = minimal length after processing words[0..i] resulting in a string with first char c1 and last char c2. Since only 26 letters, DP dimension is 26x26=676 per i; with n up to 1000, O(n*26^2) ~ 1000*676 = 676k,
